Flexible lens: One lens, two options
Selectable wide and narrow detection with one sensor. Simply switch the lens to change the shape of the detection area best suited to the installation site.
Wide Detection Area
 Narrow and Long Detection Area
A new bespoke pyro has been specifically designed to create human-size detection areas and optimise detection sensitivity. For industry leading performance, FlipX Professional sensors have a unique 
algorithm (SMDA) which can learn from the environment to discriminate popular causes of false alarms.
High-detection performance 
Refined spherical lens
OPTEX’s indoor sensors are equipped with a 
specially designed spherical lens which allows for 
very sharp focus and high-performance detection. 
OPTEX’s SMDA algorithm can 
differentiate between common 
causes of nuisance alarms, 
such as shadows and bright 
lights, to focus the detection on 
genuine intrusions.
Ease of installation
Re-designed LED indicator has been selected for clearer viewing at distance.
